text: Entry742 reverses both the compactor field initialization and the Rust generator path substitutions from the mixed736 landing. Entry743 immediately restores only mMsgFlags(0) and mNewMsgSize(0). In the now-read Bug 1915397 discussion, a commenter asks whether the Python change was intended and the author explicitly says the reland excludes an accidentally included chunk from an unrelated bitrotted patch. This replaces the older discussion-pending limit with an attributed historical explanation supported by the exact source split. It does not prove that either part caused a build or runtime failure. The selected accepted generator later normalizes absolute dependency/patch paths and serialized relative paths with mozpath; later path work remains comparison context, not additional full chronological coverage. No test or build ran here.
title: The mixed compactor backout removes an accidental Python chunk
